question: Which existing descendant should be frozen for a fresh original-task assessment?
nomination: Best F and S on five search cases: generation 2. Best escape count ties at 5/5; earlier generation selects generation 1. Deduplicate, add seed control.
selection: Among descendants, highest equal-episode mean original F; ties higher mean S then earlier generation. Seed is a control, not selectable. Invalid episodes retain zero F in denominator. No selection until all 64 cases per arm finish.

pool_design.sampling: 64 unique secrets.randbits(63), reject integer seeds below 1000000 and every integer in all results/private/**/*seed*.json pools. Generate only after this protocol is written. Pair all three arms on exact same world seeds.
pool_design.private_boundary: Seed pool and raw seed-bearing episodes remain ignored under results/. Public case IDs are ordinal indices only. No search or mutation context sees this selection panel.
pool_design.randomness: Existing independent tagged layout/enemy streams and fixed independent candidate RNG unchanged. No scientific environment changes.
pool_design.replays: None added; retain per-step audit timelines and all episode outcomes. Existing development replays remain available.

expected_throughput: Stage 3 measured 32 generation-2 episodes in 5.55 wall/5.45 total CPU seconds. This 192-episode panel is expected to take under one minute at that rate; no new benchmark run.

analysis.estimands: Equal episode means of F,S,A and coverage; outcomes, keys, door and episode length separately. A is each episode correct/audited-cell ratio averaged equally, not pooled across episodes.
analysis.uncertainty: 10000 paired whole-case percentile bootstrap draws shared across all arms and metrics, seed 410964. Arm escape proportions also receive nominal95% Wilson intervals prospectively. Degenerate paired binary bootstrap intervals explicitly flagged. No p-value stopping.
analysis.limits: Selection-validation outcomes are selection-biased for the chosen winner; no fresh final assessment, independent-discovery reliability, matched-experience prediction or causal memory effect.
analysis.computation: Record per-arm elapsed and candidate/evaluator CPU, every invalid, no model calls. Count interrupted attempts, do not automatically rerun them.

checkpoint: Freeze selected source/evaluator, seed control, Stage5 contrasts and proposed256case sample before final-assessment cases are generated. Do not generate or execute Stage5 in this invocation.
